title: Business Permits and Licensing
description: Business permit registration and renewal through the City Business Permits and Licensing Office. Detailed requirements and fees are published via the LGU's online forms and eServices pages.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa — Online Forms (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/online-forms)

title: Civil Registry Services
description: Birth, marriage, and death certificate services through the Office of the City Civil Registrar.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa — eServices (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/e-services)

title: City eServices Portal
description: The city government's online services portal for digital transactions.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa — eServices (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/e-services)

title: Online Forms
description: Downloadable and online forms published by the city government for various transactions.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa — Online Forms (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/online-forms)

title: Real Property Tax
description: Real property tax assessment and payment handled by the Office of the City Treasurer and the Office of the City Assessor. Online payment availability needs verification.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa — City Directory (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/city-directory)

title: Public Health Services
description: Public health services through the Offices of the City Health Officer and the Santa Rosa Community Hospital.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa — City Directory (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/city-directory)

title: Santa Rosa COVID-19 Vaccination Tracking (SCVT)
description: The city's vaccination tracking portal for COVID-19 immunization registration and records.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa website footer link (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/)

title: Bid Opportunities and Procurement Notices
description: Invitations to bid, bid bulletins, notices of award, and annual procurement plans published by the city government.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa — Bid Opportunities (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/bid-opportunities)

title: Social Welfare Services
description: Social welfare programs and assistance through the Office of the City Social Welfare and Development Officer.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa — City Directory (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/city-directory)

title: City Ordinances and Resolutions
description: Access to enacted city ordinances and adopted resolutions via the city government website and the Sangguniang Panlungsod.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa — City Ordinances (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/city-ordinances)

title: Public Employment Service (PESO)
description: Job facilitation and employment services through the Office of the City Public Employment Service Manager.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa — City Directory (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/city-directory)

title: Building Permits
description: Building permit applications and building code enforcement through the Office of the Building Official.
source: City Government of Santa Rosa — City Directory (https://santarosacity.gov.ph/city-directory)
